product_summary: An AI-powered agent designed to automatically identify trending topics on Reddit, extract key insights, and generate relevant, engaging post drafts for users to review and publish.
problem_statement: Content creators and marketers often struggle to keep up with rapidly changing trends on Reddit, leading to missed opportunities for timely and relevant content creation. Manually sifting through Reddit for trending topics and then crafting posts is time-consuming and inefficient.
success_metrics: Increase in the number of trending topics identified per day by 20%
Reduction in time spent by users on trend research by 30%
Average user satisfaction score of 4/5 for generated post quality
Number of generated posts reviewed and accepted by users per week

features.name: Reddit Trending Post Discovery
features.description: Automatically connect to the Reddit API to fetch posts from specified subreddits and identify those that are currently trending based on configurable metrics (e.g., upvotes, comments, recency).
acceptance_criteria: The system can successfully connect to the Reddit API.
The system can fetch posts from a configurable list of subreddits.
The system can identify and list posts as 'trending' based on a defined algorithm (e.g., top 100 posts by upvotes in the last 24 hours).
Trending posts include title, URL, subreddit, upvotes, and comment count.

features.name: Trending Topic Extraction
features.description: From the identified trending posts, use AI to extract overarching themes, keywords, and key discussion points that represent the core trending topics.
acceptance_criteria: The system can process a set of trending posts and identify distinct topics.
Each identified topic includes a concise name and relevant keywords.
The system can associate multiple trending posts with a single extracted topic.
Topic extraction accuracy is at least 80% as judged by human review.

features.name: AI Post Generation (Draft)
features.description: Generate a new Reddit-style post (title and body) based on a selected trending topic. The generated post should be relevant, engaging, and adhere to a specified tone.
acceptance_criteria: Given a trending topic, the system can generate a unique post title.
Given a trending topic, the system can generate a post body (text content).
Generated posts are grammatically correct and coherent.
Generated posts are relevant to the selected trending topic.
Users can view the generated post draft within the application.

features.name: User Interface for Trend & Post Management
features.description: A web-based interface allowing users to view trending topics, trigger post generation, and review/edit generated post drafts.
acceptance_criteria: Users can log in and access the application.
The UI displays a list of currently trending topics.
Users can select a trending topic and initiate post generation.
The UI displays generated post drafts for review.
Users can copy the generated post content to their clipboard.

features.name: Configurable Subreddit Monitoring
features.description: Allow users to specify which subreddits the agent should monitor for trending posts.
acceptance_criteria: Users can add new subreddits to a monitoring list.
Users can remove subreddits from the monitoring list.
The system only fetches posts from the configured subreddits.

features.name: Post Editing & Refinement
features.description: Provide tools within the UI to edit and refine generated post drafts before copying them.
acceptance_criteria: Users can modify the title and body of a generated post draft.
Changes made by the user are saved to the draft.

user_flows.name: Discover Trending Topics
steps: Content Creator logs into the AI Reddit Trend & Post Generator.
System automatically displays a dashboard with the latest trending topics.
Content Creator reviews the list of trending topics, including associated keywords and example posts.
related_features: User Interface for Trend & Post Management

user_flows.name: Generate a New Post Draft
steps: Content Creator views the list of trending topics.
Content Creator selects a specific trending topic of interest.
System sends a request to the AI Post Generation module.
System displays the AI-generated post draft (title and body) in the UI.
Content Creator reviews the generated post.
related_features: User Interface for Trend & Post Management

modules.name: Authentication & User Management
modules.responsibility: Handles user registration, login, session management, and user profile data.

modules.name: Reddit Integration Service
modules.responsibility: Manages all interactions with the Reddit API, including fetching posts, subreddits, and handling rate limits.

modules.name: Trend Analysis Service
modules.responsibility: Processes raw Reddit post data to identify trending topics, extract keywords, and categorize content.

modules.name: Content Generation Service
modules.responsibility: Utilizes Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate post titles and bodies based on identified trending topics.

modules.name: Post Management Service
modules.responsibility: Stores, retrieves, and manages generated post drafts, allowing for review and editing.

modules.name: User Interface (Frontend)
modules.responsibility: Provides the web-based graphical interface for users to interact with the system.

suggested_tech_stack: OpenAI API / Hugging Face Transformers (LLM for content generation)
expected_scale: Initial launch: 100-500 daily active users, processing ~50,000 Reddit posts daily. Within 1 year: 5,000-10,000 daily active users, processing ~500,000 Reddit posts daily.

data_entities.name: User
data_entities.description: Represents a user of the AI Reddit Trend & Post Generator.
relationships: One-to-Many with GeneratedPost (a user can generate many posts)

data_entities.name: RedditPost
data_entities.description: Stores raw data of a Reddit post fetched from the Reddit API.
relationships: Many-to-Many with TrendingTopic (a RedditPost can contribute to multiple topics, a topic can be derived from many posts)

data_entities.name: TrendingTopic
data_entities.description: Represents an identified trending theme or topic derived from multiple Reddit posts.
relationships: One-to-Many with GeneratedPost (a topic can inspire many generated posts)

data_entities.name: MonitoredSubreddit
data_entities.description: A list of subreddits configured by the user to be monitored for trends.

possible_apis.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token.
Retrieves a list of currently identified trending topics.
Triggers a new run of the trend discovery process (admin/scheduled).
Generates a new post draft based on a specified trending topic ID.
Retrieves all generated post drafts for the authenticated user.
Retrieves a specific generated post draft by ID.
Updates an existing generated post draft (e.g., title, body, status).
Retrieves the list of subreddits monitored by the user.
Adds a new subreddit to the user's monitored list.
Removes a subreddit from the user's monitored list.

functional_requirements: The system shall allow users to register and log in securely.
The system shall connect to the Reddit API using appropriate credentials and adhere to rate limits.
The system shall fetch posts from specified subreddits at regular intervals.
The system shall implement an algorithm to determine 'trending' posts based on upvotes, comments, and recency.
The system shall use natural language processing (NLP) to extract key topics and keywords from trending posts.
The system shall leverage a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate coherent and contextually relevant post titles and bodies.
The system shall store generated post drafts, allowing users to retrieve and review them.
The system shall provide a user-friendly web interface to display trending topics and generated posts.
The system shall allow users to copy generated post content to their clipboard.
The system shall allow users to configure which subreddits to monitor for trends (post-MVP).

non_functional_requirements.description: Trending topic discovery should complete within 15 minutes for configured subreddits.
AI post generation should complete within 10 seconds per request.
The system must be able to handle fetching and processing data from up to 100 subreddits concurrently.
The system should support up to 10,000 daily active users generating posts.
The Reddit API integration should have an uptime of 99.9%.
All user authentication and API keys must be stored and transmitted securely (e.g., HTTPS, encryption at rest).
The user interface should be intuitive and easy to navigate for content creators.
Optimize LLM API calls to minimize operational costs.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: LLM API cost per generated post < $0.05

constraints: Reliance on Reddit API terms of service, rate limits, and data availability.
Cost implications of using external Large Language Model (LLM) APIs.
Accuracy and quality of AI-generated content are subject to LLM capabilities.
The system must comply with all relevant data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) for user data.
assumptions: Reddit API will remain stable and accessible for data fetching.
Large Language Models (LLMs) are capable of generating high-quality, relevant, and engaging post content.
Users have a basic understanding of Reddit and content creation principles.
The definition of 'trending' can be adequately captured by quantifiable metrics from Reddit data.
Users will manually publish the generated posts to Reddit or other platforms.
open_questions: What is the precise algorithm or criteria for defining a 'trending' post (e.g., specific upvote thresholds, time windows, subreddit filters)?
What is the desired tone and style for the AI-generated posts (e.g., humorous, informative, formal, casual)?
Should the system support monitoring specific user-defined subreddits from MVP, or is a global set sufficient initially?
What is the maximum acceptable latency for fetching and processing Reddit data?
What is the budget allocation for LLM API usage?
Are there any specific content guidelines or censorship requirements for generated posts?
out_of_scope: Direct publishing of posts to Reddit or any other social media platform.
Advanced analytics on the performance of published posts (e.g., tracking upvotes, comments after publishing).
Integration with multiple social media platforms beyond Reddit.
User-specific customization of AI generation parameters (e.g., specific persona, writing style, length control beyond basic prompts).
Scheduling of posts for future publication.
Image or video generation for posts.
